decisions.reason: The full-application localization decision also applies to iOS, but the candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY establishing that coverage.
Choosing full application localization does not change or remove the existing Android download-size optimization goal.
Full application localization does not alter the established mechanism of hosting tutorial and graphic-heavy assets externally.
The localization coverage decision does not change the iOS size-optimization goal or its remote asset-hosting strategy.
